trap-negation-contrast.evidence: 'without phenomenological tuning' is the corpus's substantive no-free-parameter provenance claim, not manufactured contrast; 'while two-body inter-cluster bonds revert to the single-chirality density' is a real case distinction.
trap-negation-contrast.notes: Note: 'without phenomenological tuning' sits in the same sentence flagged under trap-closing-aphorism.

trap-triples.evidence: 'the symmetric particle channel, the standard propagator channel, and the alternating antiparticle channel' are the three Wedderburn blocks at n=3 — substantive.

trap-closing-aphorism.evidence: Block-final 'This categorical structure derives the {m_e, 2m_e} threshold directly from the Frobenius pairing without phenomenological tuning.' — a quotable derivation-and-no-tuning closer that adds nothing to the case formula above it, and that sits under a **Superseded** banner declaring the very density it claims to derive 'the structurally-wrong leading-order ansatz'.
trap-closing-aphorism.notes: PROPOSED (structural, not applied — the no-tuning claim is provenance the author may want kept, and the supersession makes the wording a scope question): drop the sentence, or re-scope to 'The {m_e, 2m_e} threshold follows from block activation alone; no parameter is fitted.'

trap-meta-commentary.notes: AUTHORNOTES FLAG (AGENTS.md 4d): the opening blockquote '**Superseded.** The scalar substrate density rho_q = 1/hbar_q^2 used below is the structurally-wrong leading-order ansatz; the operator-valued form supersedes it' is a status banner in prose and belongs in authorNotes kind 'deprecated' with see: mass-endomorphism-tower.

trap-thesis-restatement.evidence: 'This categorical structure derives the {m_e, 2m_e} threshold directly from the Frobenius pairing' restates the displayed case formula and the sentence 'Populating the alt block mandates its antiparticle partner by CPT symmetry, doubling the density' — third statement of the same fact.
trap-thesis-restatement.notes: Same sentence as trap-closing-aphorism; one deletion clears both.

trap-superlative.evidence: 'saturate all blocks internally' and 'directly' are mild and locally scoped.
trap-superlative.notes: VERIFIED: rho_q = 1/hbar_q^2 with hbar_q = 1 - 1/q_0 gives 101.8622 at the proton pin (101.8622 at the muon pin too — the two differ only at the 7th digit), so 'approx 102' is right.

trap-nonspeakable.evidence: 'Mass computes as the geometric volume scaled by the discrete fractional volume occupied within the Wedderburn module.' — 'Mass computes as' is not English (the verb has lost its passive), and the sentence then stacks volume-scaled-by-volume-occupied-within-module with no breath. Reads as compression damage rather than authored prose.
trap-nonspeakable.notes: PROPOSED: 'Mass is computed as the geometric volume, scaled by the fraction of the Wedderburn module the state occupies.' Not applied: 'discrete fractional volume occupied within the Wedderburn module' may name a defined quantity, so the rewrite needs the author.
